## Purpose

**Stacked on #50499; land after it.** Both target `main`, so GitHub also lists #50499's commits. The change here is the last commit: [`488e5f7d6a...bab44092cf`](https://github.com/zixi-qi/vllm/compare/488e5f7d6af2819db8abf1fb74de06ed621b1cd6...bab44092cfd90b3f3cdd4bf8b462cca64dee3a72) (4 files, +143/−125).

Follows up on a [review note on #50499](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50499#discussion_r4098037609): `_align_remote_regions_by_layer` only transforms the remote `NixlAgentMetadata`, so it does not need to live on the worker.

- Move it to `nixl/utils.py` as `align_remote_regions_by_layer(meta, layer_names, local_region_indices, local_block_lens)`. It read exactly those three pieces of worker state, which are now passed explicitly.
- Add `select_remote_regions(meta, indices)`, which reindexes every per-region metadata list in one pass. Layer routing and the existing PP layer-window slice in `add_remote_agent` both use it, replacing two hand-written copies of the same seven-field reindexing.
- The packed-layout loop iterates `zip(..., strict=True)` instead of indexing three sequences by position.

No wire-format, registration, or transfer change; the validation checks and their messages are unchanged. One tightening: the PP layer-window slice now fails with "Remote region metadata lengths disagree" when a peer's per-region list length differs from its address list, where it previously truncated silently. Real peers always send equal lengths, since `register_kv_caches` asserts it.

Not a duplicate: no open PR moves or rewrites this function. Draft #56187 also builds on #50499 and changes this function under its earlier name; whichever lands second rebases onto the other.

## Test plan

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=5700 \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl*.py
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=5700 \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_kv_load_failure_recovery.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_output_aggregator.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_tp_mapping.py
pre-commit run --files $(git diff --name-only 488e5f7d6a HEAD)
pre-commit run mypy-3.12 --hook-stage manual --files $(git diff --name-only 488e5f7d6a HEAD)
```

Existing alignment tests now call the utility through a small `_align` helper; one new test covers the tightened length check, including that a rejected peer's metadata is left unmodified.

## Test results

Head `bab44092cf` on `488e5f7d6a` (#50499 with `main` merged), four GB200s: 568 NIXL tests passed (2 ROCm-only skips) and 42 supporting tests passed; changed-file pre-commit and mypy 3.12 passed.

No model evaluation: the change moves code without changing registration or transfers. The E2E evidence for the packed MLA path (Gemma-4 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GSM8K) is in #50499.

## AI assistance

AI assistance (Claude) was used for implementation, tests, and validation. The human submitter reviewed every changed line and is responsible for the change end to end.

+def select_remote_regions(meta: NixlAgentMetadata, indices: Sequence[int]) -> None:
+    """Keep only the regions at ``indices`` in every per-region field, in order."""
+    region_lists = [getattr(meta, name) for name in _REGION_FIELDS]
+    assert all(
+        values is None or len(values) == len(meta.kv_caches_base_addr)
+        for values in region_lists
+    ), "Remote region metadata lengths disagree"
+    for name, values in zip(_REGION_FIELDS, region_lists):
+        if values is not None:
+            setattr(meta, name, [values[i] for i in indices])

+def align_remote_regions_by_layer(
+    meta: NixlAgentMetadata,
+    layer_names: Sequence[str],
+    local_region_indices: Sequence[int],
+    local_block_lens: Sequence[int],
+) -> None:
+    """Select the remote regions backing ``layer_names``, in that order.
+
+    ``local_region_indices[i]`` is the local region of ``layer_names[i]``, whose
+    block length a remote packed layer's page must match.
+    """
+    remote_region_layers = meta.region_members
+    # Region-index routing here would silently transfer stale KV.
+    assert remote_region_layers, "Remote advertised no region_members"
+    assert len(meta.kv_caches_base_addr) == len(remote_region_layers), (
+        "Remote region metadata lengths disagree"
+    )

+    remote_region_by_layer: dict[str, int] = {}

+    missing = [name for name in layer_names if name not in remote_region_by_layer]

+    layouts = meta.packed_member_layouts
+    packed_regions = {remote_region_by_layer[name] for name in layouts}

+    if meta.region_names is not None:
+        meta.region_names = list(layer_names)
+    # A packed remote row is addressed at each layer's page inside the block;
+    # the remote whole-row stride is kept as is.
+    transfer_layers = zip(
+        layer_names, remote_regions, local_region_indices, strict=True
+    )
+    for i, (layer_name, remote_region, local_region) in enumerate(transfer_layers):

+            f"Remote packed layer {layer_name!r} has no layout"

+        )

+            f"Packed MLA page sizes must match for layer {layer_name!r}"
+        )
+        meta.kv_caches_base_addr[i] += offset
+        meta.block_lens[i] = page_size
